verdict.rationale: React's own docs and GitHub explicitly document incremental adoption: adding React to an existing HTML page and rendering components anywhere on it, using 'as little or as much React as you need,' while also scaling to full apps via recommended frameworks like Next.js/React Router. This directly matches the story from small page-part to full application. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on case study confirming a real incremental migration in production.
